candidates.title: Gabbar Is Back
candidates.overview: A vigilante network taking out corrupt officials draws the notice of the authorities.

candidates.title: The Recruit
candidates.overview: A brilliant CIA trainee must prove his worth at the Farm, the agency's secret training grounds, where he learns to watch his back and trust no one.

candidates.title: The Killing Room
candidates.overview: Four volunteers sign up for what initially appears to be a typical paid research study, only to discover that they've unwittingly become involved with a classified government program that was said to have been terminated nearly two decades ago.

candidates.title: Discount
candidates.overview: To fight against the introduction of automatic checkouts that threaten their jobs, staff members at Hard Discounts secretly create their own "Alternative Discount" outlet by salvaging products that would otherwise have been wasted.

candidates.title: Black Dossier
candidates.overview: In the 1950s, in a small provincial town, a young inexperienced judge clashes with an influential notable during an investigation into a suspicious death. His perseverance to get to the truth will cause a huge scandal.

candidates.title: I Flunked, But...
candidates.overview: After the plans of a group of college students to cheat on their final exams goes awry, they're left to reassess their lives and educations and get back on track.

candidates.title: The Last Judgment
candidates.overview: In Naples, a voice from the skies announces one morning that the final judgment will be at 6 p.m. on that day. What follows is a series of vignettes depicting various people's reactions (or lack thereof) to the announcement.

candidates.title: Le Brio
candidates.overview: After an incident, a brilliant professor known for his outbursts is forced to mentor the student he wronged for a speech contest.

candidates.title: Attitude Test
candidates.overview: Four high school seniors steal an important college entrance exam and go on vacation to "study," but accidentally lose the exam while partying.

candidates.title: Lie Detector
candidates.overview: A job interview takes an awkward turn when a lie detector reveals the unfiltered truths and hidden feelings of everyone involved.

candidates.title: The Gracefield Incident
candidates.overview: On August 16, 2013, the Supreme Court mandated the CIA to declassify files that had been kept secret for the past 75 years. Visual records of documented paranormal events were released to the public. The following incident took place in Gracefield, Quebec.

candidates.title: Inside Man
candidates.overview: Based on true events. A disgraced police detective seeking redemption goes undercover to expose a violent crime syndicate. But as he sinks deeper into the mob, the price for absolution may be higher than he can afford.

candidates.title: Secrets Behind the Wall
candidates.overview: In a housing complex, a college prep student is spying on his neighbor, a former peace activist, who now leads an ordinary life as a housewife, having a secret affair with an ex-lover.

candidates.title: In the Line of Duty 4
candidates.overview: Two detectives who are up to their necks in trouble and in each other's face, as they try to shut down a drug-trafficking scheme that could be connected with international ties to organized crime. But in the midst of their investigation, innocent immigrant dock worker Luk Wan-Ting gets caught up in the mix when he witnesses the murder of an intelligence operative and is framed for the crime.

candidates.title: Scare Out
candidates.overview: After a critical intelligence leak, a national security unit launches an intensive investigation. But successive setbacks in their arrest operations reveal a shocking truth: the trail leads back to within the unit itself. Amidst a storm of trust and betrayal, a silent battle begins to unfold...

candidates.title: Por Thozhil
candidates.overview: Loganathan, a senior cop is asked to mentor Prakash, an academically bright but faint-hearted rookie and this unlikely duo team up to investigate a series of murder cases, and realize all of them are interlinked and that a psychopath serial killer is on the run.

candidates.title: Haraamkhor
candidates.overview: When a vulnerable new student finds comfort in her brash teacher, their academic relationship takes a manipulative and troubling turn.

candidates.title: Skirt Day
candidates.overview: A teacher, driven to exasperation from insults and insubordination, takes her class hostage.

human_candidates.overview: A vigilante network taking out corrupt officials draws the notice of the authorities.

human_candidates.title: The Recruit

human_candidates.title: Discount

human_candidates.overview: In the 1950s, in a small provincial town, a young inexperienced judge clashes with an influential notable during an investigation into a suspicious death. His perseverance to get to the truth will cause a huge scandal.

human_candidates.title: I Flunked, But...

human_candidates.title: The Last Judgment
human_candidates.overview: In Naples, a voice from the skies announces one morning that the final judgment will be at 6 p.m. on that day. What follows is a series of vignettes depicting various people's reactions (or lack thereof) to the announcement.

human_candidates.title: Lie Detector

human_candidates.title: The Gracefield Incident
human_candidates.overview: On August 16, 2013, the Supreme Court mandated the CIA to declassify files that had been kept secret for the past 75 years. Visual records of documented paranormal events were released to the public. The following incident took place in Gracefield, Quebec.
